subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor

716510101.text: Adventurer, thanks to your hard work, the Geovishap investigation can be brought to a close.

716510103.text: Thank you for alleviating the pressure on the Guild.

716510106.text: All the adventurers who took leave to visit their families have now returned and reported in at the Guild. You have already made a great contribution, so please, leave the remaining work to us.

716510107.text: As for why these ancient creatures suddenly began appearing, we will continue to investigate.

716510108.text: Oh, and don't forget to claim your investigation rewards.

716510109.text: The Adventurers' Guild looks forward to your continued excellence! Ad astra abyssosque!

716510105.text: Haha, it seems like you enjoyed yourself, then. That's wonderful.
